summary.text: Gregory Porter is a Democratic state representative from Indiana House District 96 who has represented the district since 1992 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works as vice president of external affairs at the Health and Hospital Corporation of Marion County.

paragraphs.text: Porter earned a bachelor's degree from Earlham College in 1978.
His professional experience includes serving as vice president of external affairs with the Health and Hospital Corporation of Marion County and as vice president of community planning.
He took office in the Indiana House in 1992.
